comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Accessed from Center of "Ancient Civilization in the Desert" Legacy Theme (unlocked by completing Legacy TH1. After King Khufu -- details on quest page and from this Guide's Legacy tab: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1CvSeFtHsnVrOpuwd0n0iudkTxy9nD3wuKiP4i5ojcB4 ).

Discovery: The Great Pyramid of Giza's Past (+500 Sophia)

Rewards are receivable upon entering this zone.

Capstone Pendant (automatically received on entering the zone)

From the 10 glowing Light Pillars set around the map, the following items may be obtained by using Search skill; they are divided by skill ranks.

R1-9:
Ancient Iron Meteorite
Architect's Waistcloth
Architect's Hairband
Sailor's Gloves

R10-15:

Sun Earrings
Ancient Civilization Decor 1
Hawk Wood Sculpture

R16:
Ancient Egyptian's Noble Dress
Ancient Egyptian Crown
Ancient Stone Blade

Zone Trade Goods (Collection):

Red Ore
Green Ore
Stone
Boulders

Caution: if you leave, log out or suffer disconnect while in this zone, you will be returned to Giza Plateau and cannot return without redoing Legacy clue combination and obtaining Center result again.
